title: Services
heading: Hardware Design & PCB Architecture
subheading: PCB engineered for signal integrity and manufacturability — from the first placement pass, not patched before a certification deadline.

seo.metaDescription: Canopy hardware design and PCB architecture services, from first placement to validation and manufacturing readiness.

sections.heading: What's Included
sections.subheading: Seven engineering tracks inside one discipline — scoped together so the board, stack-up, and silicon around it are decided by the same team.

cards.heading: Multilayer PCB Design
cards.description: Stack-up planning, impedance control, and DFM review on boards from single-sided prototypes to dense high-layer production builds.

cards.heading: Analog Design
cards.description: Low-noise front ends, precision references, and sensor conditioning designed against the real measurement budget.

cards.heading: RF Design
cards.description: Antenna placement, matching networks, and pre-compliance work for sub-GHz, BLE, Wi-Fi, and cellular radios.

cards.heading: Power Electronics
cards.description: Converters, battery management, and thermal budgets sized for the duty cycle the product actually sees in the field.

cards.heading: HF Design
cards.description: High-frequency routing with controlled impedance, careful budgeting, and signal integrity simulation before the first layout.

cards.heading: FPGA Design
cards.description: RTL, timing closure, and board-level integration for deterministic acquisition and low-latency control paths.

cards.heading: SoC Design
cards.description: Silicon selection, bring-up, and board support packages — chosen alongside the firmware team that will live on the part.

sections.heading: Solutions We Build
sections.subheading: The same hardware discipline, pointed at the product categories our clients ship.

sections.heading: Workflow
sections.subheading: Six stages from requirements to manufacturing handover — one team owns every one of them.

cards.heading: Requirements & Architecture
cards.description: Define product requirements, constraints, interfaces, and system architecture.

cards.heading: Circuit & Component Design
cards.description: Develop the circuit architecture and select appropriate components.

cards.heading: PCB Design & Layout
cards.description: Build the board layout with attention to signal integrity, power distribution, manufacturability, and reliability.

cards.heading: Prototype & Validation
cards.description: Manufacture prototypes and validate functional and environmental requirements.

cards.heading: Testing & Optimization
cards.description: Identify issues, optimize the design, and prepare the system for production.

cards.heading: Production Readiness
cards.description: Deliver production-ready documentation and support the transition into manufacturing.

sections.heading: Not a pitch. Products we've actually shipped.
sections.subheading: We take a personalized approach to each project, working closely with our clients to understand their goals and requirements.

cards.heading: Dual-Channel Smart Charger
cards.description: Power electronics and control firmware engineered together, not bolted on.

cards.heading: BLE Mesh + RS485 Board
cards.description: Mesh-networked node for energy meter retrofits — BLE Mesh upstream, RS485/Modbus downstream.

cards.heading: Edge Compute Gateway
cards.description: OTA fleet management across distributed edge nodes for smart-infrastructure deployments.
